LanguageData.SRA_BuildingDamageAdjusterDesc:
This building can resist incoming damage.
-Damage efficiency: Incoming damage is multiplied by damage efficiency before it is used to calculate durability loss.
-Damage cap: Incoming damage cannot exceed this limit. This only takes effect when the value is greater than 0.
-Damage reduction: Incoming damage is reduced by this amount. This only takes effect when the value is greater than 0.
